transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm here because... it's just been a rough few weeks. I've had this... this heavy, sad pressure just sort of sitting on me most of the day. I go to work and try to keep a smile for the patients, but... I don't know. Inside, I just feel like I'm barely holding myself together.
How long have you been feeling this way? When did you first notice these feelings starting?
It's been... about three weeks. I guess I first noticed it shortly after I... um... after I found out I was pregnant.
Do you feel this sadness most of the day, nearly every day, or does it come and go in a way that feels more reactive to things happening around you?

Um... yeah, like I said before, it's pretty much most of the day. Every day. It doesn't really come and go. Even when I'm at the clinic and trying to act normal for the patients... that heavy feeling is just always there. I don't really get a break from it.
Have you noticed a decrease in your interest or ability to take pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Usually, after my shifts, I would... I used to paint, or go to yoga, maybe salsa to decompress. But lately... I just go straight home. I just sit on the couch and... ignore my texts. None of it really feels worth the effort anymore.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you're not good enough?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I just... I don't know, I just feel empty, mostly.
Have you been feeling more tired or noticed a lack of energy lately, even when you haven't done much physically?
Um... yeah. I guess I'm pretty tired. I just... I don't have much energy for anything.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?

Um... I suppose. I'm not really eating as much. I know I should be, especially with work, but... most days food just sounds unappealing. Sometimes I'll get halfway through a clinic shift and just... realize I've only had coffee all day. Or maybe some crackers.
Have you noticed yourself moving slower than usual, or maybe feeling restless and unable to sit still?

Um... yeah. Just... slower, I guess. It feels a bit like... like I'm moving through syrup. Even just doing simple things at the clinic... grabbing wound supplies or doing my charting... it just takes me longer than it should.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or ending your life?

Um... no. I mean, I don't have a plan to actually hurt myself or anything. But... I guess... that's kind of why I finally said something at my prenatal appointment. It just scared me a little... having these thoughts where I just... I kind of wish I wouldn't wake up.
Has there been any activity, even something you used to enjoy a lot, that has brought you even a little bit of pleasure recently?

Um... no. Not really. I used to do things after my shifts... like paint, or go to a yoga class. Sometimes salsa. Just to decompress. But... lately I just go straight home. I just sit on the couch. I don't even answer texts from friends because... I don't know, none of it really feels worth the effort right now.
